response.justification: Bogdan has exceptional technical skills matching core requirements (TypeScript, fullstack, REST APIs, AWS, Kubernetes) and is already employed at re:cinq Berlin. However, his Staff Engineer seniority level creates poor role fit for an entry-level individual contributor position, raising serious retention and role satisfaction risks. His career trajectory suggests this may be an internal redeployment; clarifying the context and growth path would be essential before proceeding.
strengths: Expert-level TypeScript and Node.js proficiency with extensive fullstack and infrastructure experience across large-scale systems
Exceptional software architecture mindset—demonstrated TDD, clean code principles, and software craftsmanship aligned with role values
Already employed at re:cinq with established team integration, eliminating onboarding uncertainty and commute concerns
concerns: Severe seniority overqualification—Staff Engineer for entry-level IC role presents high risk of disengagement and rapid departure
Missing explicit experience with required frontend stack (no React mentioned, only Ember.js); PostgreSQL not listed despite SQL familiarity
Unexplained career-level step down raises questions about motivation and stability; role may be insufficient for professional growth expectations
